status: Complete observed Edmunds inventory; acquisition only, awaiting owner review; no import authorization
source: Edmunds JavaScript-rendered MY2026 US builder and exact-style specifications; existing authored Engine registry
method: Normal in-app browser navigation; enumerate all three submodel categories, expand all five multi-body trim groups, deduplicate IDs; inspect every individual builder and all 18 exact-style specification pages with selected ID verified and Engine expanded. Rendered labels/descriptions only; no access-control workaround. Read-only registry queries supply canonical engine properties.
normalization_notes: Follow MY2025 identity dimensions; separate trim and factory body, retain manufacturer trim spelling.
Deduplicate two repeated 392 style IDs across submodel catalogues; do not split transmission/axle/tire/package alternatives.
MY2026 offerings are independently observed. No MY2025 row, PHEV availability or engine combination carried forward.
Canonical engine properties are verbatim registry values with authored project code mappings; source engine-code absence is separately recorded and is not an aspiration blocker.
Engine profiles are local artifact references. Manufacturer codes in canonical_fields are project-resolved, not source-reported codes. No Engine authoring or update occurred.
Drivetrain is canonical 4WD; part-time/full-time remains supporting source detail. US market comes from US Edmunds MSRP/catalogue context, not final-assembly country.
No UUIDs, slugs or new parent records assigned. Engine UUID/PK are existing registry references only.
